title: BetterTanks — enemy AI for a 2D tank game
meta: Unity 2D · C# · academic practice at DeviDevs, May–Jul 2026
blurb: A five-state enemy tank: patrol, chase, shoot, take cover, run. The interesting part is cover selection — for every destructible wall it scores four candidate positions taken from the collider bounds, and strongly prefers the side facing away from the player. It also has to handle the wall being destroyed while it is hiding behind it.

title: A bridge between my phone and a coding agent
meta: Python 3 · Unix daemons · in daily use
blurb: A daemon that lets me approve or redirect a long-running coding agent from Telegram, so I am not tied to the laptop while it works. Behind it sits a Markdown knowledge vault that both I and the agent write to — which is exactly why it needed a real lock rather than hoping the writes do not collide.

title: Scheduled Google Workspace automation
meta: Python · Google Cloud APIs · Playwright · at DeviDevs
blurb: Internal tooling: scheduled jobs that keep a spreadsheet tracker in sync with Drive and Sheets, and a browser controller driving Chrome over the DevTools protocol for the web apps that have no usable API. Read-only credentials, and a sanitiser that strips local paths and addresses out of anything published.
